script.title: Tracking script
script.description: One tag, 4 KB, in the head of every page you measure.
script.copyFail: Could not copy the script. Select it instead.
script.gtm: Add it through Google Tag Manager
script.gtmStep1: In Tag Manager, add a new Custom HTML tag.
script.gtmStep2: Paste this snippet — not the one above — as the tag's HTML.
script.gtmStep3: Trigger it on All Pages, then publish the container. Keep {scriptUrl} off any consent-blocked category you do not need.
script.gtmNote: Tag Manager drops a data-site attribute when it injects a script, so this form carries the site ID in the URL instead.
script.rotateNote: Rotating it stops every copy of the old script at once.
script.pauseHint: The script keeps loading and records nothing. Your domains and settings are kept
script.rotateDescription: Every copy of the old script stops recording at once, including any you have forgotten about. You will need to paste the new tag on every page that carries the old one. Nothing already collected is lost.
script.pausedToast: Tracking paused. The script stops recording within five minutes.
script.rotatedToast: Site ID rotated. Paste the new tag on your website.

verify.title: Verify installation
verify.description: We load one page and look for the script, then read your Tag Manager container if it is not in the HTML.
verify.pageHint: The page has to be public. A page behind a login always fails this check.
verify.unreachableDetail: We only follow public pages, and we never follow a redirect to a private address.
verify.missingDetail: The page answered in {ms} ms, but the tag was not in the HTML. Check that it sits in the head, above anything that rewrites the page.
verify.containersNote: We also read Tag Manager container {containers}, and the tag is not in there either.
verify.gtmDropTitle: Tag Manager will drop the site ID
verify.gtmDropDetail: Container {container} carries the tag, but the site ID is not in the script URL. Tag Manager keeps only the URL when it injects a script, so a data-site attribute never reaches the page and the tracker never starts. Copy the Tag Manager snippet above and replace the tag's HTML.
verify.gtmDropPageView: A page view did arrive in the last five minutes, so something on this site is still recording.
verify.successDetail: It answered in {ms} ms. Site ID {siteId} matched, and this domain is {state} the allow list.
verify.successGtmNote: The tag is not in the HTML, so it only runs once Tag Manager fires it — a page view is the proof.
verify.successPageView: A page view arrived in the last five minutes.
verify.noPageViewYet: No page view has arrived yet — open the page in a browser to send one.
